original_test_intent: Verify thermal sensors for both PCIe switch indices 0 and 1, bind each to its upstream/downstream fabric topology and reconcile identity/readings across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web with the specification.
original_method: Identify switch 0/1 part, firmware, bus and board location plus upstream/downstream ports and endpoints; retain complete aligned IB/OOB inventories and Web rows; compare TEMP_PCIE_SW_0 and _1 values/states/thresholds while passively correlating link width/speed, errors and thermal state.
manual_activity: The platform owner maps PCIe switch 0/1 and their link paths and resolves criteria 3–28; an operator verifies both Web rows and the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: SUT/BMC/BIOS and PCIe switch 0/1 part, firmware, bus and physical identities
Upstream/downstream port, endpoint and lane/link topology per switch
Authoritative TEMP_PCIE_SW_0~1 spec and per-index IB/OOB/Web map
Normal negotiated width/speed and permitted AER/link-error baseline
Secure access, full Web capture, timing/cache/rounding rules and criteria 3–28 disposition

Correlate passive link width/speed/errors and thermal state and prepare Web parity
Report per-switch missing/extra/duplicate/stale or mismatched evidence
Perform no switch/link/threshold action, criteria invention or DUT verdict

Resolve criteria-number gap and omitted PCIe-switch checks
Review both switches and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Sensor Check - PCIE_SW'` invents an aggregate record; OOB-only/truncated evidence misses both explicit indices, IB and Web.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, select switch 0 and 1 by approved records, capture both Web rows and correlate passive topology/link health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB/OOB lists, TEMP_PCIE_SW_0~1 range, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; no log clear.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an explicit switch0/switch1 matrix bound to bus/location and upstream/downstream topology, then compare complete IB/OOB/Web telemetry with passive link health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Expands the range and adds topology traceability without active PCIe operations.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One aggregate result can hide a missing switch, swapped index or a thermal value attached to the wrong fabric branch.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware naming and topology differ by board revision; mappings must be versioned.

project_override_considerations: Switch indices cannot substitute for each other. An absent second switch needs explicit N/A approval. This row does not authorize link reset, margining or firmware change.
expected_evidence: Switch0/switch1 part/firmware/bus/location and link topology plus versioned sensor spec/map
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits
Complete Web evidence for both switches
Passive width/speed/AER/thermal context, criteria 3–28 decision, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: `grep TEMP_PCIE_SW_0~1` is not a reliable two-member expansion, criteria jump from 2 to 29, and DeepSeek invents one aggregate record with incomplete views.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive two-switch objective is clear; topology/spec/mapping and criteria are supplyable inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2025 Wistron-BMC-01045-V002: confirm PCIe switch 0 and 1 bus/location and upstream/downstream topology mappings plus expected absent behavior; confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 29 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–28 are missing, and provide the complete per-switch IB/OOB/Web acceptance map.

review_improvement: Expands both switch indices, binds each to its topology and exposes the criteria gap instead of accepting a fabricated aggregate sensor.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe switch indices are meaningful only with bus/location and fabric-path mapping. A healthy record from switch 0 cannot establish switch 1, and swapped indices could conceal a hot device on another branch. The tilde notation must be expanded as two records rather than passed to grep literally. Passive link/error context is needed, while criteria 3–28 cannot be inferred.
